testResults.name: market-lake-access-adapter
testResults.result: 40 tests passed covering the MarketLakeAdapter: ensure, terminal-job wait, and file query ordering before reader invocation, complete-coverage validation against canonical partition paths, projected egress warning before reader at the configurable threshold, injected client boundary with exactly-one-of client/client_factory validation, lazy factory resolution cached across loads, and factory failure surfacing on first load

testResults.name: repository-quality-gates
commands: uv run --python 3.12 --extra dev ruff check src/harness tests/harness
testResults.result: Scoped Ruff and repository-wide ty checks passed after wave integration

limitations: The adapter takes an injected LakeClientPort or client_factory so managed-identity credential selection stays with the caller; the concurrent T180 LakeClient credential/audience kwargs are consumed through the caller's factory without adapter-side changes
